_comment: Declarative schema map for the `analyze` pipeline.
Edit this JSON to recognise new transcript event types WITHOUT touching
src/analyze/parser.ts. Unknown top-level `type` values (or unknown
attachment.type when the wrapper is `attachment`) are silently counted
into `counters.unknown_type` and dropped — not thrown — so a Claude Code
schema bump degrades gracefully (FR-19, AC-6.1 schema drift report).
Map shape:
events.<type-key>.action            stable Event['kind'] consumers see
events.<type-key>.fields            advisory list of payload fields the
report layer relies on (documents
coupling; not enforced at runtime)
events.<type-key>.filter            optional gate; e.g. tool_use only
surfaces when name ∈ filter.name
events.<type-key>.extractCommandName when true, report.ts may parse
<command-name>...</command-name>
out of message content (D-4)
events.<type-key>.stderrMaxBytes    cap for stderr salvage (R-2 / NFR-6)
Type keys are matched against the EFFECTIVE type — for `attachment` rows
we unwrap `attachment.type` first, so `hook_success` here matches the
inner attachment, not a hypothetical top-level `hook_success` row.
